entry.title: Prada Linea Rossa x Red Bull | Skateboard Speed World Record with Diego Poncelet

media:group.media:title: Prada Linea Rossa x Red Bull | Skateboard Speed World Record with Diego Poncelet
media:group.media:description:
151.83 km/h. The fastest speed ever recorded on a skateboard. Prada Linea Rossa joins Red Bull athlete and two-time downhill world champion Diego Poncelet in the Skateboard Speed World Record project, supporting his pursuit of a historic milestone. On a closed section of Route des Éboulements in Québec, Canada, Poncelet surpasses the previous world record following years of research, training, and technical development. Working closely with the athlete, Prada Linea Rossa developed bespoke footwear and gloves, combining high-performance materials with protection, comfort, and grip. Every detail contributed to a system engineered for control at extreme speeds. A new chapter in the ongoing partnership between Prada Linea Rossa and Red Bull, challenging conventions and redefining the boundaries of human performance.

media:group.media:title: Prada Fall/Winter 2026 Eyewear Collection | Chen Haoyu in “Simple Stories”
media:group.media:description:
The simple, the honest and human inform “Simple Stories”, the Prada Fall/Winter 2026 campaign. Prada Ambassador Chen Haoyu is portrayed with Prada Eyewear in imagery that valorizes the extraordinary within the ordinary. Normalcy is captured and preserved through a cinematic lens, creating fragments of an alluded personal world. Instinctive posture and natural attitude bring an expression of individuality to each image, reflecting the campaign’s exchange between actuality and fantasy, still life and portrait.

entry.title: Made in Prada | The Making of Fall/Winter 2026 Look #10

media:group.media:title: Made in Prada | The Making of Fall/Winter 2026 Look #10
media:group.media:description:
For Prada Fall/Winter 2026 Look #10, devoré becomes a form of revelation. The technique transforms the surface through subtraction, gradually exposing hidden layers and allowing the material to carry evidence of its own transformation. What appears altered becomes a record of process, memory and change. The final piece retains visible traces of its own making, a unique expression of Prada’s craftsmanship in which imperfection, memory and transformation become signifiers of authenticity.

entry.title: Prada Re-Cashmere and Re-Wool: A New Chapter in Circularity

media:group.media:title: Prada Re-Cashmere and Re-Wool: A New Chapter in Circularity
media:group.media:description:
With Re-Cashmere and Re-Wool, Prada extends the circular approach first articulated through Re-Nylon into the register of natural fibre, translating a commitment to lower-impact responsible material sourcing into two of fashion’s most storied materials: wool and cashmere.
Here, circularity begins upstream, at the moment of making: pre-consumer offcuts, spinning residues and cutting-room remainders are gathered, sorted and recycled into high-quality secondary raw materials that return to the production cycle.
Behind each garment stands a network of specialised suppliers, bound together in close collaboration across every stage of the process. Re-Cashmere and Re-Wool are made entirely in Italy, in Tuscany and Umbria, where knitwear craftmanship finds its truest expression.

entry.title: Prada Galleria | Narrated by Tuba Avalon

media:group.media:title: Prada Galleria | Narrated by Tuba Avalon
media:group.media:description:
Tuba Avalon explores Prada Galleria: a total Prada universe across multiple floors and functions, from 1913 to today.​ At Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, the historic home of Fratelli Prada, the project brings together the expanded Prada Donna and Uomo boutiques, Marchesi 1824, Pradasphere, and Osservatorio Fondazione Prada with new spaces dedicated to invitation-only shopping and private hospitality. Across retail, hospitality, art, and history, the entire complex extends and deepens the story of Prada, drawing its different expressions into a single destination. The result is a rare, direct encounter with the multifaceted passions and preoccupations that have shaped the house since its founding.​ Explore the Prada universe at Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II in Milan.​
